finding: Live account row has no caret; it opens the account menu. Fresh isolated keyboard access also passed.
nextAction: Retain regression coverage for keyboard access and the caret-free account entry.
limitation: Verified in the inspected Chromium build; no broad assistive-technology certification.

finding: Fresh fixtures demonstrated one selected reaction, replacement, clearing by selecting again, and persistence after reload.
nextAction: Retain replacement, clearing and reload regression checks; verify complete message preservation.
limitation: Local isolated storage; cross-device reactions are not implemented.

finding: Initial direct-chat header retains the coworker identity, but Rename conversation temporarily replaces it with the conversation title (UX-011).
nextAction: Fix the shared header refresh path in UX-011, then retest short messages and rename/navigation together.
limitation: Initial render passed; the related rename path has a confirmed defect.

finding: Renaming a direct conversation temporarily replaces the coworker identity in its header with the conversation title. The stored coworker name is not changed.
nextAction: Render direct-chat headers from coworker identity after rename, consistent with showChat; test rename then navigation/reload.
limitation: Presentation/state consistency defect; no evidence of persisted coworker-name corruption.

finding: Failed runs retain partial evidence. A safe retry flow with review of already completed actions is still absent; this was already Not started in the source register.
nextAction: Design explicit retry scope and retained-action review, then test that completed operations are never silently repeated.
limitation: No unsafe repeated device operation was reproduced. This is an implementation gap, not a confirmed execution defect.

finding: A fresh Markdown fixture rendered headings, lists, table and code; injected image/script/iframe markup did not become executable elements.
limitation: Representative fixture only; this is not a comprehensive security review.

finding: A fresh raw CLI fixture rendered once and copied exact spaces, tabs and newlines to the intercepted clipboard.
limitation: Browser clipboard was intercepted; OS clipboard integration and all duplicate-output shapes were not tested. Artifact duplication is separately tracked in UX-066.

finding: Fresh tests copied the selected assistant/user messages and showed Copy failed when the clipboard rejected the write.
limitation: Clipboard API was intercepted in an isolated browser.

finding: Fixture messages on different dates received date grouping; timestamps exposed focusable accessible labels.
limitation: No screen-reader or timezone-boundary matrix was performed.

finding: Revert removed later messages and Undo restored the later target message in the isolated fixture.
limitation: Exact full-history equality and busy/queued protection were not asserted.
nextAction: Verify byte-equivalent history restoration and blocked revert while running/queued.

finding: Fork created a separate three-message branch with a parent provenance link; the parent draft remained unchanged.
limitation: Revisit after reload and exact parent-history equality were not asserted.
nextAction: Retest branch navigation/reload and parent-history preservation.

finding: Archive hid the composer; restoring and reloading made the selected chat writable again.
limitation: Exact message/evidence preservation across archive/restore was not asserted.
nextAction: Compare full history/evidence before and after archive/restore.

finding: Workspace export produced an aven-workspace envelope containing the selected fixture chat.
limitation: Selected-conversation scope, exact raw evidence/timestamps and complete secret-exclusion behavior were not asserted.
nextAction: Validate export content against source scope and raw evidence, including sensitive fields.

finding: Live profile and document UI expose SOUL/MEMORY with explicit local-only disclosure; they are not model memory or a connected behavior runtime.
limitation: Saving and consuming the same document in a real model request were not demonstrated.
nextAction: Keep local-note semantics explicit; define and test any future runtime document integration.

evidenceLevel: Direct live UI and local status GET
finding: Current OpenCode Go / mimo-v2.5 configuration is displayed. The UI explicitly says provider switching is unavailable.
nextAction: Add explicit provider setup/switching and verify the selected runtime and response provenance match.
limitation: Local configured status is not proof of provider reachability; no credentials or provider requests were used.

evidenceLevel: Direct live UI and local status GET
finding: Connections displays generic local provider diagnostics, not individual adapter connection/health state.
nextAction: Expose adapter-specific state and refresh results, with accurate unavailable/failed states.
limitation: No remote adapter health check or inventory load was performed.

finding: Live privacy copy distinguishes browser/service storage, request data and local-only notes/files; export/import controls exist.
limitation: The full destructive-operation recovery and valid-import preservation contract was not exercised.
nextAction: Verify recoverability and disclosure against every data-control path.

finding: Help opened keyboard guidance. Feedback saved locally and reported that state without an outbound request.
limitation: Tested help/feedback entries only; local storage failure for feedback was not injected.

finding: Browser preview accurately says no browser session is connected; there is no actual page preview or control session.
nextAction: Implement an authorized browser session before treating preview/control as complete.
limitation: Unavailable state passed; live browsing capability remains absent.

finding: Computer preview accurately says no computer session is connected; there is no live screen or action session.
nextAction: Implement authorized screen/action sessions with freshness and control boundaries.
limitation: Unavailable state passed; live computer control remains absent.

finding: Fresh fixture and live saved messages expose run IDs, source/model and raw command metadata separately from narrative.
limitation: Exact copied/exported evidence provenance across all timestamps and commands was not asserted.
nextAction: Verify exported/copied records preserve complete original provenance.

finding: Evidence normalization preserved target and distinguished missing output from a persisted empty string. Artifacts showed selected-run evidence.
limitation: The comparison UI and timestamp labeling across different runs were not exercised.
nextAction: Run a two-run comparison with different devices/times and missing versus empty output.

evidenceLevel: Code inspection + direct live empty state
finding: Goals has a local add/checklist surface and states that completion must cite evidence; the source contains an evidence-reference guard.
limitation: The child module check only inspected source text. Completion, persistence and invalid-evidence rejection were not behaviorally tested.
nextAction: Exercise goal creation, valid/invalid evidence completion and reload without implying agent execution.

finding: Local completion-notice and mute controls exist; broader system/attention notification delivery is incomplete.
limitation: Mute, correct destination and duplicate-event suppression were not freshly exercised.
nextAction: Test delivery, mute, link targets and deduplication before claiming notification acceptance.

finding: No skills/procedure picker with required access and version provenance exists. Local coworker notes do not implement this feature.
nextAction: Define a versioned workflow registry and explicit procedure selection/access contract.
limitation: Local documents exist, but the requested reusable workflow capability is absent.

finding: Fresh fixtures demonstrated Escape/focus return for selected dialogs and named pane controls.
limitation: A complete keyboard-only tour, focus order and trap audit were not performed.
nextAction: Complete keyboard-only navigation through every primary flow.

finding: Selected coworker and unavailable pane controls expose accessible labels/state in inspected fixtures.
limitation: No screen-reader session or complete active-run announcement test was performed.
nextAction: Verify action names, selected states and running/failure announcements with assistive technology.

evidenceLevel: Code inspection; fresh acceptance not established
finding: Responsive styling exists, but this audit did not establish measured contrast or usable controls at 200% text scale.
limitation: Historical workbook claims were not treated as fresh contrast/zoom evidence.
nextAction: Measure light/dark contrast and test real 200% text scaling and reflow.

evidenceLevel: Code inspection; fresh acceptance not established
finding: Reduced-motion CSS exists; the current browser run did not reach the intended motion assertion.
limitation: No current demonstration that all state changes remain understandable with reduced motion.
nextAction: Run a dedicated reduced-motion interaction test.

finding: Selected menus opened and Escape/focus paths were exercised in browser fixtures.
limitation: Touch, hover persistence and viewport-boundary behavior were not comprehensively checked.
nextAction: Test menus by pointer, keyboard and touch at viewport edges.

finding: Initial shell geometry checks passed at 1440/1024/768/390px; selected panes also opened in the live app.
limitation: This does not establish every pane at narrow widths or 200% zoom. No layout fix was made in this audit.
nextAction: Verify open panes, composer, menus and contained table scroll under narrow/zoomed layouts.

finding: No completed large-history performance/selection/anchor result was established in this audit.
limitation: A browser-control timeout occurred on the live artifact view; cause was not isolated and is not counted as a product defect.
nextAction: Measure responsiveness and retained scroll/selection anchors with representative long transcripts.

finding: Fresh backup serialization/parse fixture preserved format and active coworker and rejected a reserved private-key field.
limitation: It did not prove exact migration preservation of all chats, drafts, queues, avatars and revert history.
nextAction: Run an exact before/after migration comparison over the complete saved-state schema.

evidenceLevel: Fresh isolated browser contradiction + code inspection
finding: About hard-codes OpenCode / MiMo V2.5 as configured even when refreshed local diagnostics reports configured:false / Not connected.
nextAction: Derive About connection identity from the same status snapshot and preserve unknown/unavailable states.
limitation: False configuration was injected in an isolated fixture. The actual local service was configured during live inspection.

finding: Initial selected coworker identity is consistent across profile and chat; renaming a direct conversation causes the header mismatch in UX-011.
limitation: Full terminology/icon coverage was not audited; a specific identity inconsistency is confirmed.
nextAction: Fix UX-011 and review remaining object names/icons across navigation and settings.

finding: Live/context fixture discloses bounded model context and says full history remains saved; code selects a bounded history window.
limitation: A fresh over-limit request/omission-count comparison was not completed.
nextAction: Compare displayed truncation counts with actual serialized request context and retained history.

finding: Live profile and document UI explicitly disclose that SOUL/MEMORY are local notes and are not included in model requests.
limitation: This audit did not save a note and inspect the next model request to verify exclusion.
nextAction: Capture an isolated next-request payload after note editing and verify the disclosure matches it.

finding: Mark read/unread handlers exist, but the fresh persistence/opening test did not complete.
limitation: No fresh proof that unread state survives reload or that opening cannot disturb an active run.
nextAction: Exercise mark unread, reload, open and active-run preservation in a dedicated fixture.

finding: Fresh UI check showed English (system fallback) and a disabled unsupported-language choice.
limitation: This verifies honest disclosure; additional language translations are not implemented.

finding: Fresh module fixture preserved raw record content/provenance while stripping private controls. Actual local GET listed four saved runs and retrieved one matching run/chat with 13 events and reply provenance.
limitation: Existing local records only; no new provider/device run, service restart or cross-device durability test.
nextAction: Retain local readback coverage; test crash/retention behavior separately before broader durability claims.

finding: Initial selected coworker identity, profile fields and local document access were inspected. A short profile rename updated the selected sidebar name in a fixture.
nextAction: Verify profile rename synchronizes the header while leaving other coworkers unchanged.
limitation: Header synchronization after profile rename and selected-coworker isolation were not asserted.
